title: Flatness and ind-smooth closed fiber of a powered parameter quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\Lambda$ a Noetherian commutative $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $d,c\in\mathbb N$ with $c\ge1$, $P=k[X_1,\ldots,X_d]$, $\varphi:P\to\Lambda$ a $k$-algebra map, and $q\subset\Lambda$ prime. Suppose $\Lambda_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme] of dimension $d$, its maximal ideal is generated by the images of $\varphi(X_i)$, and $\kappa(q)/k$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension]. Put $J=(X_i^{8c})\subset P$ and $J_\Lambda=J\Lambda$. For any prime $q_0\subset\Lambda/J_\Lambda$ contracting to $q$, put $p_0=q_0\cap(P/J)$, $R_0=(P/J)_{p_0}$, $L_0=(\Lambda/J_\Lambda)_{q_0}$, and $I=\mathfrak m_{R_0}$. Then $R_0\to L_0$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $L_0/IL_0$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R_0/I$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. The Lean statement lifts $L_0$ to the joint universe of base, auxiliary universe and target; the algebra equivalence ULift.down identifies this with the displayed mathematical assertion. No source algebra, factorization or resolution occurs in the conclusion.

proof.text: Write P=k[x_i], p=φ⁻¹(q), e=8c. Localization maximal-ideal contraction and hgen put each φ(x_i) in q. Hence p contains the origin ideal, which is maximal with quotient k, so p is that ideal. The polynomial-origin localization is regular of dimension d, and the images of its variables are the regular system of parameters of Λ_q. They are a regular sequence. Apply flat_over_regular to obtain P_p→Λ_q flat.

Identify R₀ with P_p/(x_i^e) and L₀ with Λ_q/(φ(x_i)^e) by the quotient/localization isomorphisms. They commute with the map induced by φ, because both agree on P and on the inverted elements. Quotient flat base change gives R₀→L₀ flat. The ULift algebra equivalence preserves that flatness.

The residue base R₀/I is k via evaluation at zero. The extension IL₀ is generated by φ(x_i); hgen identifies it with the image of the maximal ideal of Λ_q, so L₀/IL₀ is κ(q). The maps preserve the given k-algebra structure. Apply separable_extension_is_filtered_colimit_smooth, regard the terms over R₀/I through its identification with k, and lift their carriers and the index category to max(u,v,w). The inclusions preserve constants, so the ring colimit is also the algebra colimit. Transport it along the ULift quotient equivalence to the displayed closed fiber. For d=0 the parameter ideals are zero and both identifications are field identifications.
